description: Quark-level bifurcation probe — per-Wedderburn-block character contributions y_λ(q) · χ^λ(β) plotted across q for each of the 6 canonical S₃ braid words (six-canonical-knot-operators) at strand count n=3. Tests whether the metallic-ratio thresholds act as bifurcation boundaries in the parametric-SDP feasibility structure at the simplest baryon-precursor level.

verdict.interpretation: If 'flips_bracketing_metallic_ratio' is high and 'flips_in_interval_interior' is low, the metallic-piecewise conjecture is confirmed at the per-block character-contribution level. If the reverse holds, the per-block bifurcations live at knot-specific algebraic numbers (consistent with the Jones probe's findings) rather than at metallic ratios.

limitations: n=3 (single-baryon strand count) only; physical nuclei A>1 need higher n.  The bifurcation structure can differ across strand counts.

Hoefsmit-Wenzl characters used directly; the closed-form expressions for χ^{(2,1)} on 2- and 3-letter words verified at q=1 to reduce to standard S₃ characters.  Higher-strand characters would need the recursive Hoefsmit formulas.

'Bifurcation' here means a sign change in a per-block contribution — necessary but not sufficient for an actual SDP-feasibility-set deformation.  A true parametric-SDP bifurcation analysis (Mehrotra-Monteiro, Goldfarb-Scheinberg) needs the active-set tracking which is not done here.
